_comment: Correction-note evidence (S2): Llama-2-7B YaRN at the paper's actual
factors, measured twice so the anchor's contribution is separable.
For each (factor, context) the pair is mis-anchored vs correctly anchored.
The gate script writes the numbers (perplexity after a full-length prompt,
the generation's early-EOS/blank-line/repetition scores, and the effective
inv_freq it asserted from the built model). These are the evidence for the
correction note; they are NEVER reported as speculative-decoding results.
`expect` is deliberately absent: this is a measurement, and the gate's
pass/fail rule is not the point here. The claim under test is that the
anchor explains most of the perplexity damage and NOT the degeneration,
which is read off the numbers rather than off a verdict.
